force_group.create_relativity.spacetime_: Geodesic acceleration from nearby gravitational sources
config.create_relativity.physics.speed_o: Used in every dimension without an override. Low values make special relativity reachable; real c would make every effect invisible.
config.create_relativity.physics.unit_ra: Sable mass whose Schwarzschild radius is one block; sets the gravitational constant. Default block mass is 1.0.
config.create_relativity.physics.speed_o: Dimension id -> c in blocks/s. Planetoid space defaults higher so block planets aren't nearly black holes.
config.create_relativity.debug.show_radi: Draw horizon (purple), photon orbits (yellow) and ISCOs (cyan; dimmer = retrograde) around every black hole.
commands.create_relativity.bh.created: Black hole at %s %s %s: r_s=%s, spin=%s, mass=%s
commands.create_relativity.bh.none: No black holes in this dimension
Bend light around black holes (post-processing). Turn off if it clashes with a shader pack.
config.create_relativity.render.environm: Render a low-res 360° view from the nearest black hole (one face per frame) so light bent from off-screen, like the photon ring, shows what's really there.
config.create_relativity.render.capture_: How far the environment capture renders. Lower is cheaper.
config.create_relativity.render.overscan: While a black hole is visible, render the world this much wider than the screen so light bent in from just off-screen is real terrain instead of the blurrier capture. Costs a little sharpness; 0 turns it off.
death.attack.create_relativity.singulari: %1$s was crushed into a singularity while fleeing %2$s
%1$s became infinitely dense trying to get away from %2$s
%1$s divided by zero to escape %2$s. It didn't help
%1$s ran out of future, and so did their argument with %2$s
%1$s is now a rounding error in a black hole's mass
%1$s is now a rounding error in a black hole's mass, thanks to %2$s
%1$s's information is technically preserved. %2$s's grudge definitely is
%1$s found out what's at the bottom
%1$s found out what's at the bottom while running from %2$s
%1$s contributed to the black hole's entropy
%1$s and %2$s contributed to the black hole's entropy. Mostly %1$s
config.create_relativity.physics.planck_: Sets ħ, and with it Hawking evaporation: a hole evaporates in 5120π·M³/(l_P²·c) seconds (M = r_s/2) and vanishes in a burst when r_s reaches this.
config.create_relativity.black_holes.eat: Most blocks inside a horizon removed per tick, per hole (their mass is swallowed). Growth needs the relativityBlackHoleGrowth gamerule.
config.create_relativity.black_holes.rip: Most blocks per tick, per hole, torn loose by tides into falling debris that spirals in. Scales down as the hole nears its Eddington limit.
A block tears loose when the hole's pull plus the world's gravity exceeds this × (1 + hardness). Dirt goes early, stone later, obsidian barely; unbreakable blocks never.
config.create_relativity.black_holes.edd: Eddington Rate (mass/s per block of r_s)
Feeding faster than this makes the disk's radiation push loose matter away.
config.create_relativity.black_holes.haw: Small holes evaporate (lifetime grows with mass cubed) and pop at the Planck length.
gamerule.relativityBlackHoleGrowth: Black holes eat blocks and grow
commands.create_relativity.bh.feed: Feeding the nearest black hole at %s mass/s (Eddington limit %s mass/s; anything above is blown away)
death.attack.create_relativity.spaghetti: %1$s became a very long noodle, chased there by %2$s
%1$s was cooked al dente by tidal forces
%1$s was cooked al dente by tidal forces; %2$s will be served next
%1$s's head and feet disagreed about gravity
%1$s's head and feet disagreed about gravity, and about running from %2$s
%1$s stretched a bit too far to get away from %2$s
%1$s was extruded through spacetime by %2$s's persistence
advancements.create_relativity.noodle_in: Be stretched to death by a black hole's tides
config.create_relativity.black_holes.bod: Tidal stretch across a body (2GM·height/r³) it can take before it starts to spaghettify. Small holes do it well outside their horizon; big ones swallow you whole.
config.create_relativity.black_holes.shi: Tidal stretch across a Sable ship (2GM·length/r³) it can take before it tears across its middle. The halves are checked again, so ships break up in a cascade as they fall.
config.create_relativity.time.dilate_tic: Entities, block entities, random ticks and scheduled ticks run at their local proper-time rate: near a hole or aboard a fast ship, machines, crops and mobs slow down by dτ/dt. Players are exempt (their clock only drifts on the HUD).
config.create_relativity.time.max_frame_: In singleplayer the world runs relative to your own clock: when you're dilated by dτ/dt the server ticks 1/(dτ/dt) times faster while you stay at normal speed. This caps that speedup (the server has to keep up).
config.create_relativity.render.light_de: See distant things as they were when their light left them: block and entity updates are held for distance / c. At c = 64 b/s, something 64 blocks away is a second in the past.
config.create_relativity.time.shaft_tors: Create networks spanning different clock rates twist: each block adds this × |its dτ/dt − the source's| stress per rpm. Long shafts down a gravity well overstress. 0 turns it off.
